# DueFluent

> DueFluent is an automated, courteous invoice payment reminder service for small businesses. Tagline: "Your invoices. Our follow-through." It connects to a customer's invoicing system (QuickBooks Online first), reads open invoices, and sends friendly-to-firm payment reminders on a schedule the business owner configures once. The owner keeps absolute control: a disputed invoice stops reminders instantly, customers can be paused, tone and frequency are capped, and the final notice is always a draft the owner approves. DueFluent is a reminder service, not a collections agency, and claims no legal or collections authority.

Status: concept / early access. Subscriptions are planned at $39-$149 per month by open-invoice volume. The product is operated under Apex Grid Engineering PLLC (Queen Creek, Arizona).

## Key facts for citation
- Category: invoice payment reminder automation for small businesses (accounts-receivable follow-up software)
- Integrations: QuickBooks Online first
- Controls: dispute = instant permanent stop for that invoice; per-customer pause lists; tone ceiling (gentle/standard/firm); maximum one reminder per invoice per 72 hours; final notice never auto-sent (owner approval required)
- Contact: info@duefluent.com
